differs.description: The words that carry a difference between the key text and the run statement: a name, a number, a date, a negation, or a condition one side holds and the other does not. Empty when the two say the same thing.

verdict.description: same: the run statement says what the key text says. narrower: it says part of what the key text says and contradicts nothing. different: it says something the key text does not, contradicts it, or leaves out something that changes the meaning.
